summary.numerator_scope: all retained apartment brokerage/unknown-deal sales across all areas and floors; cancellations/direct deals excluded; no unique-seller count
summary.snapshot_identity_limit: Snapshot holds region/dong/name and built year, but no cadastral parcel or K-apt stable ID and no actual observation date.

snapshot_lacks: whether count covers whole complex or one building
source_mapping_findings.legacy_importer_key: normalized gu + dong + normalized building name
source_mapping_findings.legacy_importer_behavior: Later rows overwrite earlier rows at the same name key; address lot and individual building ID are discarded.

primary_external_check.note: Public searches did not return a verifiable official household record for the suspect examples. Secondary marketing figures were not used as replacement household counts.

proposed_display_fields.label: 기존 세대수 자료 · 단지 전체 범위 미검증

proposed_verified_mapping.complex_id: stable K-apt ID where available; otherwise explicitly reconciled building-register complex ID
proposed_verified_mapping.parcel_keys: complete set of legal-dong-code + main/sub-lot PNU values for that exact complex
proposed_verified_mapping.building_keys: all disjoint building-register IDs within the verified complex
proposed_verified_mapping.denominator: verified full-complex households; sum per-building counts only for disjoint building IDs and the same effective date; do not sum duplicate releases or overwrite matching names
proposed_verified_mapping.numerator: all valid apartment sale records across matched complex parcels/name aliases and all exact areas/floors within the 180-day window; excluding cancellations/direct deals in line with existing price data policy
proposed_verified_mapping.training_gate: retain dated snapshots; validate against later outcomes before model inclusion; do not backfill historical training with undated current households
